title: Steamworks ISteamNews interface
note: GetNewsForApp public method: AppID, count, maxlength, enddate and feeds. maxlength=0 returns full API content; a positive limit requests a generated blurb. The separate Authed method requires a publisher key.

title: Steamworks API authentication
note: Some methods expose public data without authorization; user keys, publisher keys and protected operations are separate. No credentials or key registration used here.
